Name: Valley Herbalist
Author: AkiyaP
Description:
[size=3]This is a small mod that allows you to brew your own potions that can provide various buffs. This is mainly intended for mid-late game players who wants to tackle challenging dungeons (especially, difficult modded dungeons or the new PvE content that 1.5 update has). [/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][b]What This Mod Adds[/b][/size]
[/list]
[size=3]﻿- 3 Flower [/size][size=1](plants that grows on)[/size][size=3] Trees[/size]
[size=3]﻿- Brewing Station and Mushroom Trays[/size]
[size=3]﻿- 7 Crops[/size]
[size=3]﻿- 9 Different Potions [/size][size=2](Drinkable, their buffs stack with food items![/size][size=3])

[/size][list]
[*][size=4][b]Requiremens[/b][/size]
[/list] ﻿
[size=3]﻿- SMAPI
[/size] [size=3]﻿- JsonAssets
[/size] [size=3]﻿- Producer Framework Mod[/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][b]How does it work?[/b][/size]
[/list][size=3]
Basically, you go to Marlon and get brewing station recipe. Every new crop can be put into the station to produce something. The game will automatically tell you if you're missing ingredient(s). Different crop seeds/saplings are sold by different NPCs and sometimes only on certain seasons, so go check them out regularly!

When and where the seeds/saplings can be purchased:[/size]
[spoiler]
[size=3]Krobus: Void Orchid (Autumn), Ash Cinnamon (Autumn) Spectre Orchid Sapling (any time)[/size]
[size=3]Pierre: Firefly Orchid (Summer), Marine Orchid (Spring/Summer), Weeping Orchid Sapling (any time), Mushroom Tray Recipe [/size]
[size=3]Marlon: Managora (Spring/Fall), Brewing station recipe[/size]
[size=3]Sandy: Desert root and moonlight orchid sapling (any time) [/size]
[size=3]Dwarf: Glass orchid (winter) and mana moss (item, any time) [/size]
[/spoiler]


[list]
[*][size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[/list]
[size=3]- Like other mods that adds objects/items to the game, please remove all trees, items, and/or crops from your farm, shops, chests, and/or inventory before uninstalling the mod. If you don't do that, your game may crash the next time you try to load your save file.
﻿-  Only some of the potion have "Artisan Goods" tag. This is intentional, mainly because they look like tasty drinks (hahah).

[/size][list]
[*][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[/list]
﻿So far, I haven't found incompatibilities. "PPJA Farmer to Florist" flowers can be processed into "Flowering Tea" from this mod, and flowers from this mod can be processed in machines from there. That's the only compatibility I have known so far.
